name: ts-quality-workspace
description: ts-quality alpha - evidence, judgment, understanding, governance, legitimacy for TypeScript changes

scripts.check:with-witnesses: npm run witness:refresh --silent && node dist/packages/ts-quality/src/cli.js check
scripts.loop-doctor: bash -lc 'echo "loop-doctor: ts-quality diagnostics"; node --version || true; npm --version || true; git status --short -- . || true; exit 0'
scripts.loop-impact-plan: bash -lc 'changed=$( { git diff --name-only -- .; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard .; } | grep -v "^$" | sort -u ); echo "loop-impact-plan: changed files"; if [ -n "$changed" ]; then printf "%s\n" "$changed"; else echo "(none)"; fi; if printf "%s\n" "$changed" | grep -Eq "^(package(-lock)?\.json$|tsconfig|scripts/|packages/|test/|fixtures/|examples/artifacts/)"; then echo "impact=wide"; echo "next=npm run loop-impact-wide"; echo "reason=tooling/runtime/test/fixture/artifact surface changed; use the root verify gate"; else echo "impact=normal"; echo "next=npm run loop-impact-run"; echo "reason=docs/policy or localized non-runtime surface; use the normal validation gate"; fi'
scripts.loop-impact-run: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.loop-impact-wide: bash -lc 'echo "loop-impact-wide: explicit wide validation accepted; reason=${LOOP_WIDE_REASON:-not-provided}"; npm run verify'
